what_it_is: Every hero takes 50% less while no Cleric stands. Every fight opens with all four standing, so it pays only after a fall, for the turns left in that fight.
what_it_needs_the_ruling_to_say: Whether a fall outlasts the fight, and until what. If it does the rune pays whole fights, not turns.
what_it_cannot_be_decided_without: Its 50%, priced by what it replaces over a few turns (HQ §1), re-read over whole fights, and the Cleric's share of falls (the rate table).

what_it_is: Every hero deals 75% more while no Mage stands, on the same door, for the same few turns.
what_it_cannot_be_decided_without: Its 75%, chosen so *the three who are left do the work of four*: whether that holds over a whole fight, and the Mage's share of falls.

what_it_is: Every hero deals 45% more while a hero lies fallen, any hero: the broadest of the three.
what_it_needs_the_ruling_to_say: The same, and whether a run can then hold a hero down on purpose, which HQ §1's *Dirge farms nothing* read only inside a fight.
what_it_cannot_be_decided_without: Whether a hero left down is ever worth more than a hero raised, read over a run rather than a turn.

what_it_is: A boon event, weight 8, needing `fallen_hero` and raising the fallen at 35%. Never drawn: 0 of 3,957 events across HO's runs, because no member stands at 0 between fights.
what_it_needs_the_ruling_to_say: That a fall reaches the map as a member at 0 health. Nothing else in it needs changing.
what_it_cannot_be_decided_without: Its 35% against what a won fight returns today, 35% after the clearing heal, and what its second choice, *Carry them onward*, costs.

what_it_is: A common relic suspended since IK §6, drawn by nothing: its whole effect was the retired rest node's. Its re-cut *rides the post-fight recovery, at a number set by the ruling* (`scripts/relics.gd`).
what_it_needs_the_ruling_to_say: What the post-fight recovery of a fallen hero is, as a number.
what_it_cannot_be_decided_without: That number, and whether it is the 20% floor or the 35% he walks out with, which today are one line and a second.

what_it_is: A rare relic that works: 15% more victory heal. Its second hook, `rest_heal_add`, has no reader. The mildest of the seven, and it may need nothing.
what_it_needs_the_ruling_to_say: Whether the post-fight recovery is a thing a relic can add to.
what_it_cannot_be_decided_without: Whether the lost clause is replaced at all, and with what; `master.html`'s hook paragraph names it.

record_block: ### FOUND AT HO AND NOT FIXED
what_it_is: `map_screen._use_item` offers *the fallen* and can only answer *No one to use the Revive Potion on*. The potion works in a fight, at 50%, for 80 gold or a drop; since IJ §2 the glossary no longer says it works on the map.
what_it_needs_the_ruling_to_say: That a fallen hero can be reached on the map, and at what health the potion raises him there.
what_it_cannot_be_decided_without: Its price and its place in the loot table once it is worth a fall that lasts.
